# Creem for AI agents

First create a Creem account and copy your API key from the dashboard.

## MCP server

Add the Creem MCP server to your agent:

```
npx -y @creem/mcp-server
```

Set the environment variable `CREEM_API_KEY` (for example `CREEM_API_KEY=creem_live_51Habc123exampleKEY`).

## Creem billing skill

You help the user manage Creem billing. When they ask about a customer, look up their subscriptions first. Never issue refunds without explicit confirmation.
